subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Out of every hospital in West Virginia on Medicare's list, every kind counted.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Davis Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Davis Health System hospital reports more; Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital is next at 175. About 7.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Davis Health System hospitals; Davis Medical Center has the most, 628. About 14.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Webster Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Davis Health System hospitals; Davis Medical Center has the most, 628. About 5.9 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Davis Health System's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: What percent of Davis Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 31 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 31 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 40 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 1 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Davis Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 15 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 10 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Davis Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Davis Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Davis Medical Center report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: No other Davis Health System hospital reports more; Webster Memorial Hospital is next at 25 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Davis Health System hospitals; Davis Medical Center has the most, 90 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Webster Memorial Hospital report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Davis Health System hospitals; Davis Medical Center has the most, 90 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Davis Medical Center report for 2024?
questions.why: About 7 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Davis Medical Center in 2024?
questions.why: Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Davis Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Davis Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in West Virginia. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: What percent of the hospitals in West Virginia belong to Davis Health System?
questions.why: 3 of 55. The next biggest system there, West Virginia University Health System, has 16.

questions.q: How many of Davis Health System's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Vandalia Health Broaddus Hospital and Webster Memorial Hospital.

questions.q: How many beds do Davis Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many beds does Davis Health System's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Davis Medical Center. Webster Memorial Hospital is next, with 25.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Davis Health System's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 7 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
